Topics · Prayer and closeness to God

Why does God not answer some of my prayers?

No complete answer is claimed. The Quran holds a promise to answer, a prophet who waited, a father's grief.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell [rendered] contemptible.

Quran · Ghafir 40:60

Translation

‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

Original · Hebrew

קְרָ֥א אֵלַ֖י וְאֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ וְאַגִּ֧ידָה לְּךָ֛ גְּדֹל֥וֹת וּבְצֻר֖וֹת לֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽם׃

Jeremiah · 33:3

World English Bible

﴿كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تَكْرَهُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تُحِبُّوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَّكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Battle has been enjoined upon you while it is hateful to you. But perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you. And Allāh knows, while you know not.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:216

Translation

“For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says Yahweh. “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

Original · Hebrew

כִּ֣י לֹ֤א מַחְשְׁבוֹתַי֙ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם דְּרָכָ֑י נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ כִּֽי־גָבְה֥וּ שָׁמַ֖יִם מֵאָ֑רֶץ כֵּ֣ן גָּבְה֤וּ דְרָכַי֙ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֔ם וּמַחְשְׁבֹתַ֖י מִמַּחְשְׁבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

Isaiah · 55:8-9

World English Bible

Let us be honest: this question hurts, and no complete answer is known. The first verse promises: call on Me and I will answer you. You called, and what you asked did not happen. Some may say the promise failed. An answer can also be wider than the request. The second verse came in a hard setting, but its sentence is general: you may love what harms you and dislike what helps; God knows and you do not. That opens a possibility. It does not explain every pain.

A question for you

When your prayer went unanswered, what happened between you and God?

If you sayI drifted away
ThenThat is understandable, and many have been there. The way to Him has not closed.
If you sayI kept on, but I am tired
ThenThat endurance has worth, even unseen. The next part is about a man who kept calling in old age.
If you sayI began to doubt anyone hears
ThenAn honest doubt, and it has a place here. No one will blame you for it.

Part 2 of 3

﴿إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّا٣ قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا٤ وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا٥ يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا٦ يَـٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا٧﴾

Translation of the meaning

When he called to his Lord a private call [i.e., supplication]. He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled[807] with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy [i.e., disappointed]. And indeed, I fear the successors[808] after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir Who will inherit me[809] and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]." [He was told],[810] "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."

Translator's notes

[807] Literally, "ignited." The spread of white hair throughout the head is likened to that of fire in the bush.

[808] Those relatives from the father's side who would inherit religious authority.

[809] Inherit from me religious knowledge and prophethood.

[810] By Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) through the angels.

Quran · Maryam 19:3-7

Translation

On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father. His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.” They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.” They made signs to his father, what he would have him called. He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.

Original · Ancient Greek

Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ ἦλθον περιτεμεῖν τὸ παιδίον, καὶ ἐκάλουν αὐτὸ ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ζαχαρίαν. καὶ ἀποκριθεῖσα ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν· Οὐχί, ἀλλὰ κληθήσεται Ἰωάννης. καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτὴν ὅτι Οὐδείς ἐστιν ἐκ τῆς συγγενείας σου ὃς καλεῖται τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ. ἐνένευον δὲ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ τὸ τί ἂν θέλοι καλεῖσθαι αὐτό. καὶ αἰτήσας πινακίδιον ἔγραψεν λέγων· Ἰωάννης ἐστὶν ὄνομα αὐτοῦ. καὶ ἐθαύμασαν πάντες.

the Gospel (Luke) · 1:59-63

World English Bible

Time is a factor we leave out. Zechariah is old, his bones weak, his wife unable to bear children, and still he calls. Notice what he says: I have never been disappointed in calling You, my Lord. He does not turn harsh; he reminds himself that calling has never failed him. Then the answer came. So not every delay is a refusal. That is no promise of the exact thing you ask, only a witness that waiting may not be the story's end.

A question for you

What prayer do you keep repeating?

﴿وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Quran · Al-Anbiya 21:83

Translation

Yahweh restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. Yahweh gave Job twice as much as he had before.

Original · Hebrew

וַֽיהוָ֗ה שָׁ֚ב אֶת־שְׁב֣וּת אִיּ֔וֹב בְּהִֽתְפַּֽלְל֖וֹ בְּעַ֣ד רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַ֧יֹּסֶף יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאִיּ֖וֹב לְמִשְׁנֶֽה׃

Job · 42:10

World English Bible

And if no answer comes in this life? We cannot say why. Here the verses offer no explanation but a stance. Jacob, having lost his son, says: I take my grief and sorrow only to God. Job says: harm has touched me, and You are the most merciful. Neither demands an explanation, and neither pretends to be strong. Complaining to God is not counted as a lack of faith. Whoever does not understand can still speak.
